newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bertrand Faure rises on H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Bertrand Faure rises on H1 results.

text.p: Shares in French car parts maker Bertrand Faure traded sharply higher on Friday as the market applauded first-half profits which came in better than expected.
Traders said the stock was also boosted by expectations of a rejig of the company's capital. The stock was up 4.97 percent at 190 francs at 1007 GMT, while the market was down 0.24 percent.

Bertrand Faure posted on Thursday first-half profit of 175.8 million francs, up from 129.6 million a year ago, on turnover of 7.22 billion francs. That easily beat analysts' forecasts of profit of around 100 million francs.
